sources.title: LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NVFP4 quantization of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash — Z.ai's 320B / 18B-active natively-multimodal MoE, the first GLM to combine sparse and linear attention — for serving on vLLM. This is a weight-only NVFP4 (NVFP4-A16) checkpoint.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash, also known as ox-alpha, is Z.ai's new 320B parameter multimodal open model with 18B active parameters. GLM-5.3-Flash outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks. This article is a WIP.

sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest flagship model, delivering comprehensive advancements in complex software engineering and agent capabilities. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2, with all improvements driven by post-training. sources.title: GLM-5.3: Frontier Coding with Emergent Cyber Capabilities - z.ai
sources.snippet: Today we are releasing GLM-5.3. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training. Compared with GLM-5.2, it is much better at complex coding and long-horizon tasks: Stronger Coding: GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai Code Bench.
